newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand to guarantee 10 finance firms' note issue.
newsitem.headline: Thailand to guarantee 10 finance firms' note issue.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Tuesday it would provide sufficient funds to help 10 finance firms boost public confidence.

The central bank said its Fund for Rehabilitation and Development of Financial Institutions is prepared to guarantee repayment of promissory notes issued by these companies, so as to boost public confidence.
"BOT wants all depositors and creditors of all finance companies not to get in a panic over reports in the press and to have confidence in measures taken by the authorities," it said.

Central bank governor Rerngchai Marakanond on Monday ordered 10 finance firms, including three listed companies, to increase capital by 8.25 billion baht ($319.8 million) immediately to assure creditors that they could continue operating soundly.
He also instructed banks and finance firms to raise provisions for sub-standard assets, a measure that will require them to set aside a total 50 billion baht of reserves within two years.
The central bank statement said liquidity would be injected into finance companies through its bond repurchase window.
Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan earlier on Tuesday called on private banks and finance firms with surplus funds to help the government ease liquidity problems of other financial institutions.
